best_parts: node p11_t6_why: decomposes both wrong totals (9 from weighting migration and rebound as 2; 6 from scoring leucocytosis as 1) and gives the correct sum. Diagnostic feedback.

node p0_t11 with sure_note, then 'Show me why' (p0_t11_why): tempting model named, hint first, refutation on request. Sure_note on every trap node, and ask_confidence on every probe, so hypercorrection can fire.
node w1 then p1 ('Step 3 is yours'): faded worked case that hands the last step to the learner.
flaws: node p8 / p3 / p1 / p11: each trap (TR12, TR10, TR8, TR6) is offered on one probe only in this segment, in one form. Trap-map asks for two forms in different probes; the in-segment re-test is missing.
node p11: TR6 is tested only as a numeric total. The 'score read as diagnostic' half (7 = likely, not confirmed) is absent, and the cut-off meaning of O6 is never taught in this segment.
node p8_t12_why: look-alikes are listed for women only (ectopic, ovarian cyst, PID). O8 also asks for look-alikes by group; the child and elderly lists are not taught here.

best_parts: node p1 with p1_w1 / p1_w2 and p1_x1 / p1_x2: two distinct wrong models (the working-diagnosis model and the surgeon's model), each with its own explanation, then p1r re-asks the stem with options reordered. A clean two-level hint ladder.
node r4_x1: the arithmetic (1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 7) is spelled out after a miss, so the learner can rebuild the score.
node p2 to p2r: a miss on the MRI-first option gets the ladder rung and a re-ask in a new order. Delayed re-test within the segment.
flaws: node wx: the worked case tells the pregnancy-first rule before any probe opens the idea. This breaks ask-before-tell for the segment's first idea.

node r3 option 'Discharge, as ultrasound has excluded appendicitis' (feedback r3_x1): dominated. The stem's persisting tenderness and rising count make discharge unthinkable, so it tempts no one. Its TR8 slot needs a plausible rival.

ask_confidence is set only on p1 and p2. Key probes r2, r3, p3 and p4 have none, so their sure_notes never fire. No fast lane (no skip) anywhere in the segment. O6 cut-offs and O8 look-alikes by group are not taught.

best_parts: node d1 to d1_ok 'I know this, skip the worked case' and w1: probe first, then a faded worked case ('the first step left to you') leading into the c2 probe. Probe-first, skip lane, and fading in one pass.
nodes a5_why and a6: TR6 is tested by arithmetic and then by interpretation (a6 correct: 'likely; the score estimates risk'). It covers both halves of the trap, and the cut-off is taught.
node a1_why: the exam-form 'investigation of choice' stem, with both keys taught in order (old PYQ ultrasound; current practice CT in adults). It drills R6 and keeps the trap explicit.
flaws: node a2 option 'Discharge, the scan has excluded appendicitis': dominated by the stem's persisting tenderness and rising white count. The probe is effectively binary, and the TR8 distractor tempts only a learner who has not read the stem.
node a6 option 'Appendicitis is confirmed, so imaging can be skipped': the trap uses an absolute word and the key is hedged, so the key is findable by form. Rewrite the trap in hedged language.
nodes a1, d1, c4: one trap per probe, two options plus help. The probe discriminates one model only. Look-alikes by group (O8) are also not taught beyond the ectopic mention in c2_why.

merge_ideas: c's probe-first skeleton with fast lane and confidence on every probe, plus b's classmate-plan error-spotting probe (p1) as a second TR12 form before the pregnancy ladder. This would give TR12 two forms in-segment and a generative opener.
Add a look-alikes-by-group probe (child: mesenteric lymphadenitis; woman: ovarian cyst; elderly: caecal carcinoma) to meet O8, using b's error-spotting or c's two-option format.
a's p11_t6_why decomposition (naming the item that produced each wrong total) grafted onto c's a5 numbers node, so every TR6 wrong total explains its own error.
Make c's a2 TR8 distractor plausible by softening the stem clue (drop 'rising count'), and rewrite c's a6 trap in hedged wording so the key is not findable by form.
